page_title: BAR 4-3 CEL | Barcelona v Celta Vigo 19/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' Mario Melero is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
90+8' 4 - 3 Goal! Raphinha (Barcelona) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Vicente Guaita into right side of the goal.
90+8' Raphinha (Barcelona) is going to take the penalty!
90+7' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Barcelona!

90+7' Play continues despite the shouts by some Barcelona players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Mario Melero interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
90+3' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) picks up a yellow card.
90+2' A yellow card for bad language! Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
90+2' Raphinha (Barcelona) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona. What a wasted chance that is! A precise cross into the box finds Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo), whose header flies way wide of the left post.
89' That's the end of the game for Ilaix Moriba, who is replaced by Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo).
88' Hansi Flick prepares a substitution. Gerard Martin is replaced by Pau Victor (Barcelona).
87' Substitution. Pau Cubarsi will be replaced by Eric Garcia (Barcelona).
87' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
87' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) sends an accurate short pass. Pau Cubarsi controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.

84' Gavi (Barcelona) does well to meet the corner from Raphinha, but his close-range header is soft and goes miles wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
84' Raphinha (Barcelona) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
83' The Barcelona players are exchanging some short passes.
81' Pedri (Barcelona) and Dani Olmo attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
80' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) sends an accurate pass to Jules Kounde, who controls the ball with a fine first touch.
79' A cross from a corner kick by Celta Vigo is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
78' Problems for Hansi Flick as Robert Lewandowski is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Gavi (Barcelona) replaces him.
78' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
77' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) passes the ball onto Dani Olmo, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
76' Barcelona keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
76' 72:28 – the ratio of ball possession.
74' Substitution. Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) replaces Pablo Duran.
73' Claudio Giraldez decides to make a substitution. Borja Iglesias will be replaced by Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo).

73' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) beautifully controls a cross from the wing inside the box, but he fails to test the keeper and sends his shot miles past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.

73' Pedri (Barcelona) and Jules Kounde have been trying to find each other with some accurate passes ever since the match started. These two definitely combine the most and are the team's most creative players.
71' Barcelona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
70' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 14:10.

68' 3 - 3 Lamine Yamal sends a superb cross into the box. Raphinha (Barcelona) latches on to it and from close range plants a header into the bottom right corner, leaving Vicente Guaita beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 3:3.
67' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is penalised for a foul. Mario Melero had a clear view and blows his whistle.
66' Raphinha (Barcelona) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

64' 2 - 3 Raphinha produces a sweet pass and picks out Dani Olmo (Barcelona) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the bottom right corner and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 2:3!
62' 1 - 3 Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Wojciech Szczesny with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:3.
62' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
60' The game has come to an end for Williot Swedberg. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo).
59' Hansi Flick has decided to substitute Ferran Torres and he is replaced by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona).
59' The referee allows time for a substitution. Fermin Lopez will be replaced by Dani Olmo (Barcelona).
59' Wojciech Szczesny pulls off a great save to deny Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the top of the net.
56' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Barcelona.
52' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) receives a great chance inside the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner.

51' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a low shot from long range which went towards the middle of the goal, but Vicente Guaita was ready and made a save.
50' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) produces a promising shot towards the left side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Wojciech Szczesny thwarts him and the score remains the same.
49' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) sends a chip pass into the box, but Vicente Guaita is quickest to intercept the ball.
48' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) finds Robert Lewandowski with a nice pass so he can go on towards the goal.
47' Mario Melero blows for a foul after Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Claudio Giraldez gives a chance to Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) and Iker Losada is off.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' The ball goes out of play and it is going to be a throw-in.
45+1' Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Pedri (Barcelona) switches the play to Raphinha and their attacking move continues.

43' The opposition back off Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort towards the bottom right corner, but Wojciech Szczesny denies him with the save.
39' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the free kick from mid-range, but he balloons his effort high over the bar. What a miskick! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
37' Barcelona enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
32' Neat passing move from Barcelona in order to create new attacking opportunities.
30' Shots on target – 2:2.
27' Raphinha (Barcelona) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Vicente Guaita is alert and denies him with a nice save.
27' Raphinha (Barcelona) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
27' The Celta Vigo players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
26' Rough tackle by Pedri (Barcelona). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
22' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Mario Melero no option but to blow his whistle.

22' Celta Vigo exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely. The ball is out of play. Barcelona will take a throw-in.
22' Celta Vigo control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
20' Great teamplay by Barcelona as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
15' 1 - 1 Goal! Wojciech Szczesny makes a huge mistake and Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 1:1.
14' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Mario Melero blows for a foul. Barcelona are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

12' 1 - 0 Goal! Ferran Torres (Barcelona) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Vicente Guaita had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:0.
10' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Raphinha.
9' The ball is out of play. Barcelona win a corner kick.
7' A player from Celta Vigo commits a rough challenge. Mario Melero blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Barcelona have a free kick.
3' The Barcelona players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
2' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Celta Vigo will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Mario Melero.
